title: Eiffel Tower was built to stand for only 20 years, saved by radio antenna

author: TOI LIFESTYLE DESK
description: At just four years and eleven months old, Atharva Kirti Sagar from Bengaluru has made headlines by reading an impressive 1,676 words from a chapter called 'A Send-off Party' in under 27 minutes. This remarkable accomplishment has earned him recognition from the India Book of Records in the Young Achievers category, highlighting the talent and potential of young readers throughout India.
title: Bengaluru boy, 4, reads 1,676 words, enters India Book of Records

author: PRATYUSH RAJ
description: Services pacer Jayant Goyat's maiden five-wicket haul, in his 12th first-class match, has strengthened his belief in an India dream. The 21-year-old from Bhiwani, whose father was part of Haryana's Ranji Trophy squad during Kapil Dev's last season, discusses his journey from India Under-19 cricket, the challenges of bowling on Palam's flat surfaces and the support that keeps him going.
title: Father played alongside Kapil Dev, son Jayant wants to wear India colours

author: TOI LIFESTYLE DESK
description: K. B. Kiruthikarani, a talented teen from Chennai, has captivated readers with her two poetry collections that explore the beauty of nature. Her first book, 'Dewdrops: A Gallery of Nature Poetry', debuted in 2023, followed by 'Earthen Writes: The Diary of an Earthling' in 2024. At just 15, she was honored by the India Book of Records, showcasing her profound love for the natural world through her verse.
title: Chennai teen writes 160 nature poems and publishes two books before 15

author: SHIVANGHI PAYAL
description: Oil prices experienced a notable downturn, with Brent crude slipping below $95 and WTI declining beneath $90. This trend follows substantial losses from earlier sessions, influenced by the political shifts stemming from the US midterm elections. The election results could reshape President Donald Trump's stance towards the Iran conflict, opening doors for potential negotiations.
title: Crude crashes below $100: Brent, WTI hit over two-month lows after midterm elections

author: AMIT KUMAR
description: Virat Kohli made batting look easy in India's first ODI against New Zealand in Auckland on Wednesday. The star batter scored 74 runs off 51 balls to help India win the match by five wickets (DLS) and take a 1-0 lead in the five-match series. India had to chase a revised target of 143 runs in 32 overs. Kohli made sure there was no late drama as India reached the target in just 22.4 overs. Kohli hit 13 fours and a six during his innings. His shots through the covers and pulls were among the highlights of his knock.
title: 'God help you': Shastri as Virat Kohli breaks Sachin Tendulkar's record

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: In a remarkable case in New Jersey, a homeowner secured $173,000 in damages after an oak tree, reported multiple times as hazardous, fell and damaged her property. The nearby utility company was found negligent in maintaining the tree. Following a favorable jury ruling, the appeals court affirmed the decision, underscoring the obligation of the utility company to address known risks.
title: New Jersey woman wins $173,000 after warned-about oak tree hits home

author: TNN
description: Gundla Pravalika succumbed to her injuries ten days after she was pushed off a bus. The fatal incident occurred during an argument over bus fare with B Mounika. Following Pravalika's death, police changed the charges against Mounika from attempt to murder to murder. The state government expressed condolences and promised support for Pravalika's family, including a job and insurance.
title: Woman conductor dies after being pushed off moving bus in Telangana

author: TNN
title: 2 Naga outfits clashed over one's ties with security forces

author: GLOBAL SPORTS DESK
description: Shohei Ohtani purchased a $7.85 million mansion in California's La Cañada Flintridge in May 2024 after signing his record-breaking Dodgers contract. The 7,327-square-foot property features a swimming pool, private theatre, sauna, gym and basketball court. However, reports that his address had been exposed raised privacy concerns, with suggestions that he wanted to sell the home. Realtor.com reported in April 2025 that he still owned the property.
title: Shohei Ohtani's $7.85 million mansion purchase sparked privacy concerns in 2024

author: GLOBAL SPORTS DESK
description: In 2024, Patrick Mahomes and Brittany Mahomes' KC Current partnered with Nuuly and United Way of Greater Kansas City to donate nearly 100 designer dresses to local young women. The initiative welcomed 60 members of the Boys & Girls Clubs of Greater Kansas City, offering them outfits for special occasions. Players Hailie Mace, Gabrielle Robinson and Nichelle Prince also joined the event, which focused on confidence and self-expression.
title: Patrick and Brittany Mahomes' KC Current helps 60 women find their dream dresses

author: TOI LIFESTYLE DESK
description: Meet Indira Amma, a remarkable 85-year-old teacher hailing from Kerala, who creatively employs sand and a stick to engage her young students. She introduces them to the fundamentals of Malayalam, Hindi, English, and mathematics using this unique approach. Children delight in tracing letters in the sand after watching her demonstrations, promoting a fun and waste-free learning environment.
title: Kerala grandmother, 85, teaches children with sand and stick for a decade

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: Over 100 enthusiastic volunteers gathered at George Mason University to create essential food and mental health kits. This initiative addresses the pressing issues of food insecurity and emotional stress among students and families. An impressive total of 35,000 meal kits and 400 mental health kits were assembled during the event. These vital resources will provide year-round support to individuals in Northern Virginia, demonstrating a strong commitment to community welfare.
title: Kevin Bacon's charity volunteers pack 35,000 meal kits for Virginia families

author: AMIT ANAND CHOUDHARY
title: SC says population control laws need review as fertility rate falls

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: A rare silver coin, crafted over 150 years ago, fetched an astonishing $4.758 million at a Hong Kong auction. This exceptional piece was part of the proposed Kwan Ping Trade Coinage aimed at solidifying trade currency standards in China. Hidden from public view since the mid-20th century, its mystery adds to its allure.
title: Rare 1867 silver coin made for Shanghai trade sells for $4.758m
